deployment_policy.local_smoke_role: validate launch, logging, metrics, and profiling plumbing only

workloads.name: append_throughput
workloads.description: Append/write fixed-size records as fast as each system's fixed-baseline client path allows.
workloads.comparability_note: Current local smoke runs validate plumbing but are not final comparable distributed results. ChronoLog smoke used a minimal 5-operation client path and must be rerun with the common append_throughput workload before final comparison.

workloads.name: append_latency
workloads.description: Record per-operation append/write latency for fixed-size records.

workloads.name: range_retrieval
workloads.description: Read/range retrieval over previously appended records when comparable APIs exist.

workloads.name: mixed_append_read
workloads.description: Concurrent append and read/range workload when comparable APIs exist.
